scope: Supporter-auth and supporter-browser-api entrypoint aggregate telemetry only

files.why: Project finite operations and outcomes into the reviewed aggregate schema; ignore native caller club/trace values, use only server-configured browser club, and conservatively mark invoked mutation failures unknown.

Expose Node-testable private capability execution so the actual identity services run once under the entrypoint observation; preserve sanitized RPC results and keep public ingress free of identity execution imports.

Observe each native request and scheduled maintenance once, retaining original response, authorization, receipt and cleanup behavior; a refresh-reuse revocation or lost mutation acknowledgement remains unknown in telemetry.
Delegate the private read capability to the tested wrapper and register detached metrics with the actual Worker execution context.
Observe each private browser identity capability once and scheduled secret expiry once with the Worker execution context; preserve cookie, CSRF, session and receipt behavior.
Observe the existing aggregate health read once without identity key provisioning or sender retries.
Record finite browser identity, history and checkout operations at public ingress without private request fields; preserve original unknown financial/identity responses, keys and cookies.

Exercise actual SQLite-backed native/private-browser services, privacy, caller-controlled routes, refresh-reuse revocation, lost acknowledgement, scheduled cleanup and disabled/throwing/rejecting/hung sink behavior.
Exercise actual browser session/CSRF ingress, one observation per boundary, a real checkout commit followed by lost acknowledgement, no repeated domain writes, privacy and independent sink failures.

retainedFailureEvidence.cause: Test expected 503 for an unauthenticated request; the existing authenticated transport correctly returned 401. Corrected the test expectation; no authentication behavior weakened.

policy.traceAuthority: Locally generated UUID only; incoming traces and request IDs are omitted.
policy.nativeClub: Null; arbitrary caller route IDs are never copied to metrics.
policy.browserClub: Canonical positive bounded BROWSER_CLUB_ID from server configuration only.
policy.privacy: Finite service/operation/outcome and bounded timing/club projection only. No phone, user/session IDs, credentials, cookie/CSRF, IP, URL, request/response body, SQL or error diagnostics.
policy.boundaryCounting: One observation per invoked entrypoint; public gateway and private identity capability are distinct boundaries. No domain-service instrumentation or repeated domain execution.
policy.failures: Disabled/unreviewed telemetry emits nothing; one detached sink attempt, shared default 25 ms deadline, no retry or raw console fallback. Throwing, rejecting and hung sinks cannot change identity/financial response.
policy.mutationOutcomes: Any failure after an identity mutation is invoked is conservatively unknown, including refresh reuse that revokes a family before returning 401. No rollback or retry is inferred.
policy.configuration: Distributed configurations remain disabled and contain no metrics binding, retention or approved policy. Local fixtures explicitly enable synthetic settings only.

limits: SQLite fixtures exercise actual domain services, not deployed D1/workerd or live Worker RPC. Thin WorkerEntrypoint wrappers were locally bundled with Wrangler.
No metrics sink was deployed or bound, no accountable retention policy selected, and no provider, store or production acceptance was performed.
Metric completion describes an observed capability result; it is not proof of OTP delivery, payment settlement, account erasure or production readiness.
